part1.name: Scope Compliance
part1.description: Bidder has addressed all items in the scope of supply and confirmed ability to deliver within the tender timeline.

part1.name: Technical Specifications
part1.description: Bidder's proposed equipment meets or exceeds the minimum technical specifications defined in the tender.

part1.name: Safety Standards
part1.description: Proposed equipment complies with all applicable Australian / site-specific safety standards and regulations (e.g. AS/NZS, MDG15).

part1.name: Environmental Compliance
part1.description: Equipment meets emissions and noise standards required by site environmental permit conditions.

part1.name: OEM Support & Parts Availability
part1.description: Bidder has confirmed local dealer support, parts warehouse and service capability within the required response time.

part1.name: Warranty Terms
part1.description: Bidder has provided a clear warranty statement covering minimum periods for major components as specified in the tender.

part1.name: Training Provision
part1.description: Bidder has confirmed operator and maintainer training provision, including materials and on-site delivery if required.

part1.name: Delivery Schedule
part1.description: Bidder has provided a realistic delivery and commissioning schedule meeting the site's required in-service date.

part1.name: Commercial & Financial Terms
part1.description: Bidder has accepted or provided acceptable redlines to standard payment terms, INCOTERMS and commercial conditions.

part1.name: Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Documentation
part1.description: Bidder has submitted required HSE documentation including safety data sheets, risk assessments and site-specific compliance declarations.

sub_criteria.name: Operator Protection System (OPS)
sub_criteria.description: Quality and certification of ROPS/FOPS/OPS structure; compliance with current standards.

sub_criteria.name: Proximity Detection & Collision Avoidance
sub_criteria.description: Availability, integration quality and maturity of on-board proximity detection system.

sub_criteria.name: Fire Suppression System
sub_criteria.description: Type, coverage and reliability of the OEM-integrated fire suppression system.

sub_criteria.name: Lighting & Visibility
sub_criteria.description: LED lighting coverage, camera systems, mirrors and blind-spot management.

sub_criteria.name: Fatigue Monitoring
sub_criteria.description: Availability and integration of fatigue and distraction monitoring system.

sub_criteria.name: Emergency Egress
sub_criteria.description: Ease and speed of operator egress in emergency; secondary egress provision.

sub_criteria.name: Safety Certification & Compliance Records
sub_criteria.description: Evidence of compliance with relevant safety standards; incident history; regulatory approvals.

sub_criteria.name: Ground-Level Maintenance Design
sub_criteria.description: Degree to which maintenance tasks are accessible at ground level, reducing working-at-height risk.

sub_criteria.name: Brake System Redundancy
sub_criteria.description: Redundancy and reliability of service, secondary and park brake systems.

sub_criteria.name: Rollover & Tip-Over Stability
sub_criteria.description: Static and dynamic stability index; slope rating; stability assist technology.

sub_criteria.name: Rated Payload / Output Capacity
sub_criteria.description: Equipment's rated payload or production capacity versus the tender requirement.

sub_criteria.name: Cycle Time Performance
sub_criteria.description: Typical cycle times (loading, travel, dump, return) under site conditions.

sub_criteria.name: Machine Availability (OEM Fleet Data)
sub_criteria.description: OEM-reported or independently verified fleet mechanical availability figures.

sub_criteria.name: Powertrain Performance
sub_criteria.description: Engine power, torque curve, rimpull and gradeability relevant to site gradients and haul profiles.

sub_criteria.name: Autonomous / Semi-Autonomous Readiness
sub_criteria.description: Current or roadmap capability for autonomous or tele-remote operation integration.

sub_criteria.name: Fleet Management System Integration
sub_criteria.description: Compatibility with site's existing FMS (e.g. Komatsu KOMTRAX, Cat MineStar, Modular DISPATCH).

sub_criteria.name: Tyre Management
sub_criteria.description: Tyre options available; TKPH ratings for site conditions; tyre pressure monitoring.

sub_criteria.name: Payload Management System
sub_criteria.description: On-board payload management accuracy, reporting and integration capability.

sub_criteria.name: Body Design / Bucket Capacity
sub_criteria.description: Bowl or bucket design optimisation for material type; liner options; struck vs heaped capacity.

sub_criteria.name: Operator Productivity Aids
sub_criteria.description: Technology aids that improve operator efficiency: grade control, load assist, shift data logging.

sub_criteria.name: Fuel Consumption (L/hr or L/t)
sub_criteria.description: OEM-stated or independently verified fuel burn under relevant duty cycle.

sub_criteria.name: Scheduled Maintenance Intervals & Cost
sub_criteria.description: PM interval (hours), time to complete, parts cost and lube volumes.

sub_criteria.name: Tyre Life & Cost per Hour
sub_criteria.description: Expected tyre life under site conditions and all-in tyre cost per operating hour.

sub_criteria.name: Ground Engaging Tools (GET) Life & Cost
sub_criteria.description: Expected GET/wear part life and cost per bank cubic metre or per hour.

sub_criteria.name: Component Rebuild / Exchange Programme
sub_criteria.description: Availability, pricing and terms of OEM component rebuild or exchange programme for major assemblies.

sub_criteria.name: Warranty Cost Inclusion
sub_criteria.description: Scope of items covered under warranty; costs included vs excluded; extended warranty options.

sub_criteria.name: Energy Recovery / Efficiency Technology
sub_criteria.description: Trolley-assist compatibility, regenerative braking, hybrid/electric driveline options.

sub_criteria.name: Unscheduled Maintenance Frequency
sub_criteria.description: Historical unscheduled maintenance events per 1000 hours from OEM reference fleet data.

sub_criteria.name: Transition Plan Quality
sub_criteria.description: Clarity, completeness and realism of the bidder's proposed change management and cut-over plan.

sub_criteria.name: Training Programme Depth
sub_criteria.description: Hours, format and assessment rigour of operator and maintainer training; simulator availability.

sub_criteria.name: Commissioning & Acceptance Support
sub_criteria.description: OEM commissioning team availability, duration of on-site support, acceptance test protocol.

sub_criteria.name: Tooling & Workshop Requirements
sub_criteria.description: Special tooling, lifting equipment and workshop infrastructure required; cost and lead time.

sub_criteria.name: Fleet Commonality with Existing Equipment
sub_criteria.description: Component, fluid, and system commonality with equipment already operated on site.

sub_criteria.name: Digital Onboarding & Documentation
sub_criteria.description: Quality of electronic maintenance manuals, parts books and interactive training materials.

sub_criteria.name: Ergonomics & Adjustability
sub_criteria.description: Seat, steering column, pedal and control adjustability; fit for range of operator body sizes.

sub_criteria.name: Cab Noise & Vibration (NVH)
sub_criteria.description: Measured or OEM-rated cab noise levels (dB(A)); whole-body vibration index.

sub_criteria.name: Climate Control
sub_criteria.description: HVAC capacity and quality for site ambient conditions; air filtration; pressurisation.

sub_criteria.name: Visibility & Camera Systems
sub_criteria.description: Direct and camera-assisted visibility; monitor quality and placement; blind-spot elimination.

sub_criteria.name: Operator Interface / Controls
sub_criteria.description: Intuitiveness of control layout; joystick vs lever; touchscreen quality; display readability in sunlight.

sub_criteria.name: Ingress / Egress Safety
sub_criteria.description: Step and handrail design; angle of ascent; anti-slip surfaces; three-point contact compliance.

sub_criteria.name: Operator Fatigue Features
sub_criteria.description: Seat suspension quality; lumbar support; break reminder; environmental comfort features.

sub_criteria.name: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
sub_criteria.description: OEM or third-party reported MTBF for major systems in comparable operating environments.

sub_criteria.name: Condition Monitoring Integration
sub_criteria.description: Oil analysis ports, vibration sensors, on-board diagnostics depth, remote health monitoring.

sub_criteria.name: Component Accessibility
sub_criteria.description: Ease of access to filters, fluids, wear parts and major components; time to complete routine tasks.

sub_criteria.name: Dealer Workshop Capability
sub_criteria.description: Local dealer workshop tooling, OEM-trained technician numbers and experience level.

sub_criteria.name: Parts Availability & Lead Times
sub_criteria.description: Local warehouse stockholding of A-class parts; emergency parts lead time guarantees.

sub_criteria.name: Scheduled Maintenance System
sub_criteria.description: Clarity and logic of the PM system; lube charts; oil and fluid specifications; metric consistency.

sub_criteria.name: Electrical Architecture Robustness
sub_criteria.description: CAN-bus reliability; harness routing protection; ingress protection ratings; fault diagnosis ease.

sub_criteria.name: Hydraulic System Design
sub_criteria.description: Hose routing protection, quick-connect fittings, contamination control, filter access.

sub_criteria.name: Corrosion & Dust Protection
sub_criteria.description: Paint specification, sealing, ingress protection of electrical and pneumatic components for site conditions.

sub_criteria.name: OEM Reliability Track Record
sub_criteria.description: Published reliability data, reference site performance, industry awards or benchmarking results.

sub_criteria.name: Exhaust Emissions Standard
sub_criteria.description: Tier / Stage emission certification; NOx, PM and CO2 performance relative to current standards.

sub_criteria.name: Noise Emissions
sub_criteria.description: External noise levels at operator position and bystander distances; compliance with site noise limits.

sub_criteria.name: Fluid Spill Risk Management
sub_criteria.description: Double-wall hydraulic hoses, spill containment trays, fast-fill contamination controls.

sub_criteria.name: Electric / Hybrid / Alternative Fuel Pathway
sub_criteria.description: OEM's stated roadmap for decarbonisation options; current hybrid/electric model availability.

sub_criteria.name: Tyre & Consumable Waste Management
sub_criteria.description: OEM programme for recycling or responsible disposal of tyres, batteries and fluids.

sub_criteria.name: Dust Suppression Systems
sub_criteria.description: Onboard water suppression, enclosed cab filtration contribution to site dust management plan.

sub_criteria.name: Local Dealer Presence & Responsiveness
sub_criteria.description: Geographic proximity of dealer branch, field service team size and guaranteed response time.

sub_criteria.name: Technical Field Support Quality
sub_criteria.description: OEM field engineer availability, qualifications and experience with the proposed model.

sub_criteria.name: Customer Reference Sites
sub_criteria.description: Quality and relevance of reference sites provided; willingness to facilitate site visits.

sub_criteria.name: Contract Management & Account Management
sub_criteria.description: Dedicated account manager assignment, escalation pathways and performance review cadence.

sub_criteria.name: Digital Platform & Reporting
sub_criteria.description: Customer portal, maintenance scheduling system, fleet data visibility and reporting capability.

sub_criteria.name: 24 / 7 Support Coverage
sub_criteria.description: After-hours breakdown support capability; on-call technician availability; remote diagnostic support.

sub_criteria.name: Continuous Improvement Programme
sub_criteria.description: OEM's process for sharing product improvements, service bulletins and retrofit upgrades.

sub_criteria.name: Training Facilities
sub_criteria.description: Quality of OEM training centre; simulator access; certified trainer qualification programme.

sub_criteria.name: Acceptance of Capstone Standard T&Cs
sub_criteria.description: Degree to which bidder accepts Capstone's standard purchase T&Cs without material redlines.

sub_criteria.name: Liability & Indemnity
sub_criteria.description: Reasonableness of liability caps and indemnity provisions; alignment with Capstone's risk appetite.

sub_criteria.name: Liquidated Damages / Delay Provisions
sub_criteria.description: Presence and reasonableness of LD clauses for delivery delays and performance shortfalls.

sub_criteria.name: Dispute Resolution
sub_criteria.description: Proposed dispute resolution mechanism; jurisdiction; arbitration vs litigation preference.

sub_criteria.name: Intellectual Property
sub_criteria.description: IP provisions for diagnostic software, commissioning tools and equipment data.

sub_criteria.name: Force Majeure & Change-in-Law
sub_criteria.description: Scope and reasonableness of force majeure clause; change-in-law risk allocation.

sub_criteria.name: Standard Warranty Period
sub_criteria.description: Duration (months and/or hours) of standard warranty for machine and major components.

sub_criteria.name: Warranty Coverage Scope
sub_criteria.description: Breadth of warranty: parts only vs parts + labour; callout included; consumables exclusions.

sub_criteria.name: Powertrain Warranty
sub_criteria.description: Specific warranty terms for engine, transmission, final drives and powertrain components.

sub_criteria.name: Structural Warranty
sub_criteria.description: Frame, boom and structural component warranty; fatigue crack coverage.

sub_criteria.name: Extended Warranty Options
sub_criteria.description: Availability, cost and terms of extended warranty or Repair & Maintenance agreements.

sub_criteria.name: Warranty Claims Process
sub_criteria.description: Speed and ease of warranty claims; OEM approval time; reimbursement of third-party labour.

sub_criteria.name: Warranty Void Conditions
sub_criteria.description: Clarity and reasonableness of conditions that would void warranty (fuel, oil, operator abuse).

sub_criteria.name: Recommended Spare Parts List (RSPL)
sub_criteria.description: Quality and completeness of the RSPL provided with the tender; accuracy of pricing.

sub_criteria.name: Parts Pricing Mechanism
sub_criteria.description: Fixed vs CPI-linked pricing; volume discount structure; price guarantee period.

sub_criteria.name: Local Parts Stockholding
sub_criteria.description: A-class and B-class parts held in local warehouse; demonstrated fill rate.

sub_criteria.name: Emergency Parts Delivery
sub_criteria.description: AOG (aircraft on ground equivalent) parts service; maximum lead time guarantee; air freight provisions.

sub_criteria.name: Parts Catalogue & Ordering System
sub_criteria.description: Quality of online parts catalogue; ease of part identification and ordering; PO integration.

sub_criteria.name: Obsolescence Management
sub_criteria.description: OEM's policy for providing parts support over the expected 15–20 year machine life.

sub_criteria.name: Alternative / Non-OEM Parts Policy
sub_criteria.description: OEM's position on use of approved equivalent parts; impact on warranty.
